# Proxiima

Typed, owner-scoped durable memory for agents.

- Documentation: https://aquilo-solution-s.github.io/Proxiima/
- Agent ritual: https://aquilo-solution-s.github.io/Proxiima/agents/
- Runtime instructions: MCP resource proxiima://how-to
- Runtime contracts: MCP tools/list, resources/list, resources/templates/list, proxiima://tools
- REST contract when enabled: /v1/openapi.json
- Repository: https://github.com/Aquilo-Solution-S/proxiima
